name: Rip Van Winkle Bridge
facts: The Rip Van Winkle Bridge, a 5,040‑foot cantilever marvel, opened on July 2, 1935, costing $2.4 million—about $56.4 million today—after the New York State Bridge Authority was newly formed.
In 1985, a fireworks display celebrated the bridge’s 50th anniversary, while a 2009 repainting project removed all lead‑based paint, safeguarding the structure and its travelers.
A pedestrian walkway, finished in 2018, links the bridge to the Hudson River Skywalk, connecting the historic homes of Thomas Cole and Frederic Church.
